abstract: Preservation of fertility was carried out in 28 young patients with malignant germ cell tumors of the ovary from 1962 through 1987. The pathologic diagnosis was immature teratoma in 16, endodermal sinus tumor in 7, dysgerminoma in 2, and germ cell tumor of mixed type in 3. At laparotomy, 16 patients were proved to have stage I disease, 1 had stage II disease, 9 had stage III disease, and 2 had stage IV disease. The tumor was confined to one ovary in all 22 cases treated for the first time, and the preserved ovary and uterus were normal in all 6 referred cases with recurrent diseases. Postoperative chemotherapy was given to all patients except two with stage I immature teratoma. Persistent remission was achieved in 22 patients; 5 patients died and 1 was lost to follow-up. The duration of follow-up was more than 1 year for all surviving patients, more than 3 years in 16 cases (72.7%), and more than 5 years in 13 cases (59.1%). The menstrual periods were normal in all except 3 cases, of whom 2 were below the age of 12 and one failed to menstruate at the age of 21 with a hypoplastic uterus and underdeveloped secondary sex characters. Among 12 married patients, 7 of 10 desirous of child-birth became pregnant during follow-up. Of these, 6 had a normal term delivery and 1 is currently pregnant. The preliminary conclusion is that preservation of fertility for young patients with malignant germ cell tumors of the ovary, regardless of the stage of the disease, is a safe and practicable procedure in the absence of involvement of the contralateral ovary and uterus.
abstract_ja: 妊孕性温存は、1962年から1987年の間に、悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する若年患者28例に対して実施された。病理診断は未熟奇形腫16例、卵黄嚢腫瘍7例、ディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)2例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍3例であった。開腹時、病期Iは16例、病期IIは1例、病期IIIは9例、病期IVは2例であった。初回治療の22例では全例で腫瘍は一側卵巣に限局していた。再発例として紹介された6例では、温存された卵巣と子宮は全例で正常であった。術後化学療法は、病期Iの未熟奇形腫2例を除く全例に施行された。22例で持続的な寛解が得られた。5例が死亡し、1例は追跡不能となった。生存例の追跡期間は全例で1年以上、16例(72.7%)で3年以上、13例(59.1%)で5年以上であった。月経周期は、3例を除き全例で正常であった。そのうち2例は12歳未満、1例は21歳になっても月経がなく、子宮低形成と二次性徴の発育不全を認めた。既婚の12例のうち、出産を希望した10例中7例が追跡期間中に妊娠した。そのうち6例は正常分娩に至り、1例は現在妊娠中である。予備的結論として、対側卵巣と子宮に病変がなければ、病期にかかわらず悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の若年患者に対する妊孕性温存は、安全かつ実施可能な手技である。
